facts.fact: EU SEE (Hivos) reports that on 13 October 2026 the Niamey High Court of First Instance convicted lawyer Lirwana Abdourahmane, prosecuted under Article 31 of the law on cybercrime over a social media post, and sentenced him to two years unsuspended and a 2 million CFA franc fine.
EU SEE (Hivos) reports a Niamey court convicted a lawyer under Article 31 of Niger's law on cybercrime on 13 October 2026, showing the law is applied.
